summary: Bail appeal in money laundering case linked to teacher recruitment scams; twin conditions under PMLA s.45; prolonged incarceration vs statutory restrictions; no charge in predicate offense but role in proceeds of crime; Rs.151.2 crores seized; parity with co-accused rejected; high-ranking ministerial status; no threat to investigation or witnesses established; bail granted considering age, health, elapsed time.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.4
